DashboardSupport.title: A personal appeal
DashboardSupport.p1: We generally don't ask, but today we need your help. Genie AI is an independent project, built to provide you with the most advanced AI tools without the big corporate price tag.
DashboardSupport.p2: It takes a lot of resources to keep our servers running and to develop new innovative features. If everyone reading this gave a small amount, we could keep Genie AI thriving for years to come.
DashboardSupport.p3: If you find value in what we do, please consider supporting us. It only takes a minute, and it makes a huge difference.

Metadata.title: Genie AI: OpenAI, Gemini & Claude All-in-One Platform
Metadata.description: Unlock your creativity with Genie AI. The ultimate AI SaaS platform integrating OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude for text, code, image, video, and music generation.
Metadata.keywords: Genie AI, AI Platform, Gemini AI, Claude AI, AI SaaS, Memory System, Slack Integration, Content Creation, Smartest AI Assistant

hero.badge: Memory-native AI · Hybrid Inference · Infrastructure You Control
hero.subhead: Tech Genie gives you persistent memory, model-aware routing, and flexible inference across self-hosted open-source models and premium frontier APIs — all behind one shared intelligence layer.
hero.title: The Smartest AI Assistant Ever Built
hero.description: Streamline your workflow with our advanced Memory System, Slack Integration, and Content Creation tools. Powered by Gemini and Anthropic models for the best results.

ucol.title: One intelligence layer. Multiple inference paths.
ucol.subtitle: Tech Genie routes requests across self-hosted open models and premium frontier APIs using task type, memory confidence, latency, and cost — while preserving the same context layer underneath.
ucol.card1Body: Self-host efficient open-source inference on Lambda GPU infrastructure for fast, cost-controlled responses.
ucol.card2Body: Escalate high-stakes prompts to premium providers only when deeper reasoning or output quality justifies the cost.
ucol.card3Body: Keep one persistent context layer across every model so user memory, project state, and prior work compound over time.
ucol.card4Body: Decide dynamically using task type, confidence, latency, and budget — not manual model switching.

memory.title: Context that compounds across every model
memory.subtitle: Tech Genie stores user preferences, project history, technical context, and prior interactions in a shared memory layer that every model can read from and contribute to.
memory.stat2Label: Context for chat, code, research, and agents

features.title: A platform for memory-native AI products
features.subtitle: Everything you need to build hybrid AI workflows with persistent context, flexible inference, and production-grade integrations.
features.conversationDesc: Chat backed by persistent memory, context retrieval, and model-aware routing.
features.codeDesc: Generate, review, and iterate with agents that remember project structure and engineering context.
features.researchDesc: Blend web retrieval, memory, and reasoning into reusable research workflows.
features.hybridDesc: Route between self-hosted open models and premium APIs based on cost, speed, and confidence.
features.memoryLayerDesc: Store user, project, and system knowledge in one shared intelligence substrate.
features.infrastructureDesc: Deploy on hosted or self-managed GPU infrastructure without changing the product surface.

cta.title: Build on a context layer you can actually own
cta.subtitle: Tech Genie gives you persistent memory, hybrid inference, and model routing designed to evolve with your product — not trap it inside one provider.

pricing.title: Flexible Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pay only for what you generate.
pricing.disclaimer: Prices are estimated based on standard usage.

infrastructure.title: Run the models you want on infrastructure you control
infrastructure.subtitle: Start with hosted inference, move high-volume paths to self-hosted open models, and keep premium APIs as selective fallback. Tech Genie is built for hybrid deployment from day one.
infrastructure.card1Body: Deploy open-source models on your own Lambda Labs GPU infrastructure for predictable cost and lower vendor dependence.
infrastructure.card2Body: Swap in open-weight models from Hugging Face without rebuilding your memory or routing layer.
infrastructure.card3Body: Use frontier APIs only where they deliver a clear quality advantage — not as the default path for every request.
infrastructure.card4Body: As models improve and prices shift, Tech Genie lets you adapt the inference layer without rewriting the product.
